WSP Parsons Brinckerhoff and DNV GL (2015). Industrial Decarbonisation and Energy Efficiency Roadmaps to 2050: Chemicals (main report and Appendices A-D). Prepared for the Department of Energy and Climate Change (DECC) and the Department for Business, Innovation and Skills (BIS), London, March 2015. No DOI or report number printed. https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/industrial-decarbonisation-and-energy-efficiency-roadmaps-to-2050

Locators are printed page numbers: "Report p.N" = footer of the 96-page main report; "App. p.N" = footer of the 73-page Appendices. Roadmap with 2012 base year, UK; no specific energy consumption per tonne and no process temperatures. Main file (8 technologies): TRL and CO2 saving (emissions-reduction-potential, % vs current process, sector level) for the whole technologies in the Appendix C options register, plus boiler lifetime. Register capex is GBP million for the whole UK sector (Appendix C footnote 7), not per unit or per site, so no capex rows are in the main file; all 28 register options (rows 03 and 06 are absent in the source) are in _measures with CO2 saving, cost, and TRL/adoption/applicability and the other savings in the note. Savings are relative to current processes; negative = more energy or feedstock. CCS costs are for capture alone (purification and compression included, transport and storage excluded). Not loaded: Appendix B (social and business findings), Appendix D deployment charts, enablers/barriers, interviews, survey. Traps: pdftotext layout of Appendix C is garbled (superscript footnote markers glued to TRL text, e.g. "6 10" = TRL 6 + footnote 10; "5-7 9"); values were read against pdfplumber table cells. Option 04 (decarbonised methane) prints fossil fuel saving 0% with CO2 saving 100%. No price year is stated for any cost. All headline GBP values rounded (model output rounded to 1 significant figure).
